node.title: Re^7: webperl: fetching data over the web
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
> The endless loop of initializing/ended is also interesting, something I haven't seen yet, could you tell me the steps to reproduce that?
  • download the zip-dir
  • deflate
  • mkdir democode
  • browse [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/tree/master/web/democode|github democode]
  • download all 4 files "raw" into the dir democode
  • start plack
  • open [HTTP://localhost:5000/democode/demo.html]
NB demo.html not index.html like in the online version.

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
